odaSpecification.section: 20.4.93 SORTENTSTABLE; common non-entity header in section 20.1
odaSpecification.scope: Count and sort H values in data stream, common parent/reactor links, soft-pointer block owner and soft-pointer entity list in handle stream. Sort keys are values rather than necessarily object identities.

extraction.method: Import the pinned drawing through dx_iface; test-only friend accesses m_opaqueDwgSourceFrames at (importGeneration, 0x236); write its m_rawBytes to a scratch file. The observation reports type 529, 46 object bytes, 214 handle-stream bits, parent 0x200, one reactor, class AcDbSortentsTable and no typed payload validation. It is an opaque raw carrier, not a completed typed source proof.

bitObserver.algorithm: Verify pinned SHA-256s of source, opaque raw frame and LibreDWG trace; isolate the peer 0x236 decoder block and assert its versioned field values, roles and start offsets. Independently read MSB-first bits of the 46-byte raw carrier: decode BOT type, self handle, empty EED, reactor count, xdict bit, BL count and six code-0 key handles; check no-string footer; decode relative parent, reactor, block owner and six role-4 entity handles with exact field endpoints. Compare every entity/key pair in source wire order with the peer. The matched ODA DXF pairing and block order are independently described in the prior ODA receipt.

proof.scope: Exact source-bound raw shape and peer field starts/roles only; terminal padding has no asserted semantics, no output or native behavior qualification.

negativeControls.interpretation: All 46 byte-prefix truncation controls are refused by the exact 46-byte frame-length condition; they do not independently prove a general dynamic-length parser. The six terminal bit changes are accepted intentionally because terminal padding contents have not been qualified as semantic data. No output or retry behavior was exercised.

adjacentFrameBoundary.independentTraceObservation: LibreDWG v0.14 reports object-map record 195 at trace coordinate 418479, 46-byte body, valid CRC 2AE1 for 418479–418529, then its next record 196 at coordinate 418531 with type 530 and handle 0x237.
adjacentFrameBoundary.limit: These are peer decoder coordinates/CRC statements, not independently validated source-file physical offsets. The scratch raw-frame observer checks a fixed extracted payload only and does not decode the framing prefix, CRC, object map, or the following record itself. Thus a complete independently byte-bound adjacent-frame proof is not claimed.

limits: One exact unauthenticated AC1024 source and one opaque source frame; no broad version, class, graph, producer, native draw-order or output admission claim.
The source frame itself, output, peer traces and scratch tools are uncommitted and may be ephemeral. Pseudocode and hashes above document their roles; no drawing fixture was committed.
This does not validate named-block DXF schema acceptance, actual consumer ordering, unrelated dynamic-block dependencies, NOD closure, destination rollback or same-writer retries.
